# Copilot instructions

Read and follow the repository's root `AGENTS.md`; it is the canonical source for
project commands, architecture constraints, change workflow, and definition of
done.

Use project skills from `.github/skills/` when a request involves creating or
maintaining a feature specification or architecture decision, or preparing work
for Copilot cloud execution. Do not duplicate the contents of `AGENTS.md` in
this file.
